title: Commission an Apex Control Hub
summary: Connect power and Ethernet, verify the safe-state indicators, and complete first-login commissioning for version 2.0.

sections.title: Before you begin
paragraphs: Use an isolated lab network and a regulated 24 VDC supply rated for the connected loads.

warning.condition: Power is present while field wiring is being changed.
warning.consequence: Unexpected outputs or a short circuit can damage equipment.
warning.avoidance: Remove field power and verify zero energy before changing wiring.

sections.title: Commission the controller
paragraphs: The controller starts in a disabled-output state and requests a new administrator credential.
steps: Connect protective earth and 24 VDC power.
Connect the service port to an isolated network.
Open https://192.0.2.20 and verify the displayed device identifier.
Create an administrator credential and store it outside the project files.
Confirm that every output remains disabled before attaching field loads.
